Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that Vivien Leigh was married to Peter Finch (1958–1967). This is a factual hallucination; Vivien Leigh was never married to Peter Finch. She was married to Herbert Leigh Holman (1932–1933) and Laurence Olivier (1940–1960). Peter Finch was actually married to Vivien Leigh's daughter, Suzanne Olivier, not to Vivien herself. This error propagated through the conversation, leading to a completely wrong final answer.
